preconditions.description: Number of nodes and operations are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct nodes within the valid range.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in operations)
preconditions.description: Each operation specifies two distinct nodes within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(c, int) for c in result)
postconditions.description: Each element in the result is an integer.
The result contains exactly n elements, one for each node.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= c <= n - 1 for c in result)
postconditions.description: Each count c is within the valid range [0, n-1].

postconditions.expression: all(c == sum(1 for j in range(1, n+1) if j != i and len(set(node_lists[i]) & set(node_lists[j])) > 0) for i in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: For each node i, ci is the number of nodes j (j ≠ i) that share at least one common number with node i.
